title: A pigeon's skeleton
why: Find the backbone, the wing bones and the big chest bone that holds the flight muscles.
credit: “Pigeon (Columbidae) skeleton” by LJMUZoology, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A lizard's skeleton
why: Follow the backbone from the head all the way down the tail, and see the four legs sticking out sideways.
credit: “Coppery grass lizard” by Blackburn Lab, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
